title: Permutation recovery
statementMd:
Vasya has written some permutation $p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$ of integers from $1$ to $n$, so for all $1 \leq i \leq n$ it is true that $1 \leq p_i \leq n$ and all $p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$ are different. After that he wrote $n$ numbers $next_1, next_2, \ldots, next_n$. The number $next_i$ is equal to the minimal index $i \lt j \leq n$, such that $p_j \gt p_i$. If there is no such $j$ let's let's define as $next_i = n + 1$.

In the evening Vasya went home from school and due to rain, his notebook got wet. Now it is impossible to read some written numbers. Permutation and some values $next_i$ are completely lost! If for some $i$ the value $next_i$ is lost, let's say that $next_i = -1$.

You are given numbers $next_1, next_2, \ldots, next_n$ (maybe some of them are equal to $-1$). Help Vasya to find such permutation $p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$ of integers from $1$ to $n$, that he can write it to the notebook and all numbers $next_i$, which are not equal to $-1$, will be correct.

## Input

The first line contains one integer $t$ — the number of test cases ($1 \leq t \leq 100\,000$).

Next $2 \cdot t$ lines contains the description of test cases,two lines for each. The first line contains one integer $n$ — the length of the permutation, written by Vasya ($1 \leq n \leq 500\,000$). The second line contains $n$ integers $next_1, next_2, \ldots, next_n$, separated by spaces ($next_i = -1$ or $i \lt next_i \leq n + 1$).

It is guaranteed, that the sum of $n$ in all test cases doesn't exceed $500\,000$.

In **hacks** you can only use one test case, so $T = 1$.

## Output

Print $T$ lines, in $i$-th of them answer to the $i$-th test case.

If there is no such permutations $p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$ of integers from $1$ to $n$, that Vasya could write, print the only number $-1$.

In the other case print $n$ different integers $p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$, separated by spaces ($1 \leq p_i \leq n$). All defined values of $next_i$ which are not equal to $-1$ should be computed correctly $p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$ using defenition given in the statement of the problem. If there exists more than one solution you can find any of them.

## Note

In the first test case for permutation $p = [1, 2, 3]$ Vasya should write $next = [2, 3, 4]$, because each number in permutation is less than next. It's easy to see, that it is the only satisfying permutation.

In the third test case, any permutation can be the answer because all numbers $next_i$ are lost.

In the fourth test case, there is no satisfying permutation, so the answer is $-1$.
statementZhMd:
Vasya 写下了一个由 $1$ 到 $n$ 的整数构成的排列 $p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$，因此对于所有 $1 \leq i \leq n$，都有 $1 \leq p_i \leq n$，且 $p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$ 两两不同。随后，他又写下了 $n$ 个数 $next_1, next_2, \ldots, next_n$。其中，$next_i$ 等于满足 $i \lt j \leq n$ 且 $p_j \gt p_i$ 的最小下标 $j$。如果不存在这样的 $j$，则定义 $next_i = n + 1$。

傍晚，Vasya 放学回家时遇到了雨，他的笔记本被淋湿了。现在，笔记本上写下的一些数字已经无法读取。排列以及部分 $next_i$ 的值完全丢失了！如果某个 $i$ 对应的 $next_i$ 丢失了，就令 $next_i = -1$。

现在给定 $next_1, next_2, \ldots, next_n$（其中一些值可能等于 $-1$）。请帮助 Vasya 找到一个由 $1$ 到 $n$ 的整数构成的排列 $p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$，使得他可以将其写回笔记本，并且所有不等于 $-1$ 的 $next_i$ 都是正确的。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $t$ —— 测试用例的数量（$1 \leq t \leq 100\,000$）。

接下来的 $2 \cdot t$ 行描述各个测试用例，每个测试用例占两行。第一行包含一个整数 $n$ —— Vasya 所写排列的长度（$1 \leq n \leq 500\,000$）。第二行包含 $n$ 个整数 $next_1, next_2, \ldots, next_n$，用空格分隔（$next_i = -1$ 或 $i \lt next_i \leq n + 1$）。

保证所有测试用例中的 $n$ 之和不超过 $500\,000$。

在 **hacks** 中只能使用一个测试用例，因此 $T = 1$。

## 输出格式

输出 $T$ 行，第 $i$ 行给出第 $i$ 个测试用例的答案。

如果不存在满足条件的排列 $p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$，使 Vasya 能够将其写入笔记本，则输出唯一的数 $-1$。

否则，输出 $n$ 个两两不同的整数 $p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$，用空格分隔（$1 \leq p_i \leq n$）。所有不等于 $-1$ 的已知 $next_i$ 都必须根据题目描述中的定义，由排列 $p_1, p_2, \ldots, p_n$ 正确计算得到。如果存在多个解，输出其中任意一个即可。

## 说明

在第一个测试用例中，对于排列 $p = [1, 2, 3]$，Vasya 应该写下 $next = [2, 3, 4]$，因为排列中的每个数都小于它后面的下一个数。显然，这是唯一满足条件的排列。

在第三个测试用例中，任意排列都可以作为答案，因为所有 $next_i$ 的值都丢失了。

在第四个测试用例中，不存在满足条件的排列，因此答案为 $-1$。
